target_model: All business record writes lower to one Mutation Planner and Committer; orchestration owners may authorize and schedule work but may not duplicate mutation correctness.

entries.authorizer: Record Application object action plus RLS, CLS and field policy
entries.schema_defaults_owner: Record create and update application services
entries.validation_owner: Record domain normalization, relation, unique, duplicate and lifecycle policies
entries.idempotency_owner: Record create mutation execution; update/delete optimistic precondition
entries.audit_owner: Record Application builds AuditEvent in the same commit
entries.outbox_workflow_owner: Record Application prepares automation outbox and workflow intents in the same commit
entries.post_commit_owner: Record mutation completion dispatcher and identity synchronization
entries.failure_semantics: Stable AppError; commit rollback leaves no record, audit, outbox or workflow partial fact

entries.authorizer: Agent tool allowlist and approval, then Record Application authorization
entries.idempotency_owner: Integration invocation request plus Record create idempotency
entries.audit_owner: Integration invocation audit plus Record mutation audit
entries.failure_semantics: Tool invocation returns stable failure or approval_required; delegated mutation remains atomic

entries.authorizer: Action Application permission and object policy gates before either executor
entries.schema_defaults_owner: Record Application for System Operations; generated Domain SDK plans for Business Handlers
entries.validation_owner: Action Application payload contract followed by the selected mutation planner
entries.idempotency_owner: ActionUnitOfWorkManager claims the execution receipt before executor dispatch
entries.transaction_owner: Runtime-owned ActionUnitOfWorkManager lazily opens one adapter-private transaction before System Operation planning, the first Business Handler Mutation/CAS/GetForUpdate, or a read-only Action completion, then commits Mutation, Audit, DurableIntent and the fenced Receipt through that same transaction
entries.audit_owner: Mutation planners build mutation audit facts and Action Application builds the successful Action audit before the shared Action transaction commits
entries.outbox_workflow_owner: Record mutation plans and Business Handler DurableIntent, persisted through the existing integration outbox table as the single asynchronous delivery channel
entries.post_commit_owner: No successful Action fact owner; asynchronous workers consume committed DurableIntent after the Action transaction
entries.failure_semantics: Panic, cancel, timeout, deadlock and business/mutation conflict roll back the lazy Action transaction with distinct stable codes; an ambiguous database commit is commit_unknown, retains writing as unresolved local phase, and must reconcile through the same idempotency identity instead of claiming rollback
entries.current_execution_owner: HTTP, Workflow, Automation, Scheduler, Integration, Agent and Bulk source-bound adapters -> application/action ActionApplicationService -> independent SystemOperationExecutor or BusinessHandlerExecutor

entries.authorizer: Published workflow run-as principal and Action permission contract
entries.validation_owner: Workflow reference validator then Action validator
entries.idempotency_owner: Workflow process/node invocation identity and Action invocation
entries.transaction_owner: Action owns business mutation; Workflow owns process state
entries.audit_owner: Action audit and Workflow process events
entries.post_commit_owner: Workflow engine resumes from Action result
entries.failure_semantics: Node on_error and retry policy handle stable Action failure without copying mutation logic

entries.schema_defaults_owner: Record planner candidate plus pure Automation derivation
entries.validation_owner: Automation before-phase allowlist and Record re-normalization
entries.transaction_owner: No commit owner; pure reducer runs during canonical planning
entries.failure_semantics: Failure rejects the originating plan before commit

entries.idempotency_owner: Stable outbox dedup key and downstream invocation scope
entries.transaction_owner: Originating commit persists outbox; consumer uses a new transaction
entries.audit_owner: Originating audit plus downstream execution audit
entries.post_commit_owner: Outbox worker with retry and loop controls
entries.failure_semantics: Post-commit retry; never rolls back an already committed source fact

entries.authorizer: Canonical Record or Action mutation principal
entries.schema_defaults_owner: Canonical Record planner after pure self patch
entries.validation_owner: State transition policy and Manifest effect contract
entries.outbox_workflow_owner: Parent Record mutation; external effects require published Action
entries.failure_semantics: Invalid transition or external effect is rejected before planning; self patch commits atomically with the parent record

entries.authorizer: Pipeline action permission and record scope
entries.schema_defaults_owner: Canonical Record create and update planners
entries.validation_owner: Pipeline stage policy plus canonical Record planners
entries.idempotency_owner: Action mutation context and optimistic Record precondition
entries.transaction_owner: Mutation Kernel CommitBatch over canonical item and history plans
entries.outbox_workflow_owner: Canonical Record planners with declared action workflow trigger
entries.post_commit_owner: Canonical committed-workflow dispatcher and identity projection
entries.failure_semantics: Item, history, audit, outbox and workflow intents roll back as one canonical mutation batch

entries.authorizer: Object import permission, data scope and field write policy
entries.schema_defaults_owner: Import preview and Record create callback
entries.validation_owner: Import validator plus Record create policies
entries.idempotency_owner: Import batch key plus derived row key
entries.transaction_owner: Each row currently commits through a Record create execution
entries.audit_owner: Per-record audit plus batch import audit
entries.failure_semantics: Invalid preview blocks apply; retry resumes by row idempotency without duplicating completed rows

entries.authorizer: Runtime-global worker scope for execution and Operations permission for recovery
entries.validation_owner: Record Timer schedule validator and explicit internal object allowlist
entries.idempotency_owner: Record timer identity, immutable event identity and lease/fencing token
entries.audit_owner: Immutable record_timer_event facts and Operations receipts
entries.outbox_workflow_owner: Target owner dispatch after a fenced claim
entries.failure_semantics: Lease/fencing conflict loses claim; retry is bounded; exhaustion is recoverable only through the owner adapter

entries.authorizer: Verified connector or agent identity mapped to a workspace Principal
entries.validation_owner: Integration input contract then Record policies
entries.idempotency_owner: External event or invocation id plus Record mutation scope
entries.failure_semantics: Stable connector error; retry must reuse external event id

entries.authorizer: Privacy lifecycle system scope with declared subject mapping
entries.validation_owner: Subject lifecycle declaration and explicit field set
entries.transaction_owner: Direct repository update per declared record
entries.failure_semantics: Request fails with recoverable progress; it never broadens beyond declared fields

entries.authorizer: Installation bootstrap system scope or installation workspace administrator
entries.schema_defaults_owner: Published Object schema and canonical Record default policy
entries.validation_owner: BusinessSeed authoring plus canonical Record normalization and validation
entries.idempotency_owner: Stable seed key plus normalized content hash and provenance
entries.transaction_owner: Seed repository insert; direct authoring compensates the inserted Record if provenance persistence fails
entries.audit_owner: Bootstrap installation evidence or direct business_seed_materialized audit
entries.failure_semantics: Installation fails and can be retried with stable record keys; direct authoring replays identical content, rejects conflicting content, and compensates a provenance failure

entries.authorizer: Runtime-owned governed export artifact plus compiler-validated report export control mapping; requester permissions are rechecked separately and may already be revoked
entries.schema_defaults_owner: Published report export audit Object schema
entries.validation_owner: Manifest report export control validation restricts the mapped audit object, status field and terminal values
entries.idempotency_owner: Artifact identity plus conditional prepared-status precondition
entries.transaction_owner: Single Record repository conditional status update
entries.audit_owner: Report Application appends the corresponding download denied or expired audit event
entries.outbox_workflow_owner: None by design for a terminal governance fact
entries.failure_semantics: A permission change remains fail-closed; the conditional transition cannot overwrite a concurrent downloaded or other terminal state
